explication: OCTO Web is a React workplace client for browser and Electron desktop, with an extension surface. Users enter the app, work across messaging and collaboration features, and exchange data with OCTO Server; the desktop shell adds native capabilities. The graph preserves documented product areas and sampled integrations, but many feature implementations were not excerpted, so their internal links are omitted rather than inferred.
